b604709774f26492.description: About DHL DHL is recognized as the world's most international company, having pioneered cross-border express delivery in 1969. Operating in over 220 countries and territories, DHL connects people and improves lives through global trade, focusing on service, quality, and sustainability. The Role: Digital Marketing Specialist The Digital Marketing Specialist for DHL Express Saudi Arabia is responsible for executing digital marketing activities to enhance online visibility, generate qualified leads, and improve customer acquisition, engagement, and adoption of digital shipping solutions. This full-time position is based in the Eastern Region, covering Dammam, Al Khobar, and Dhahran, and reports to the Marketing & Communications Manager. The role involves managing approved digital campaigns, content, customer journeys, and performance reporting, collaborating with Sales, agencies, and regional teams to achieve measurable commercial outcomes. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Translate marketing priorities into digital campaign plans, defining audiences, channels, budgets, timelines, and measurable objectives. Support digital campaigns aligned with commercial priorities to generate qualified leads, drive customer acquisition, and support revenue growth. Set up, monitor, and optimize paid search and paid social campaigns, managing targeting, keywords, creative testing, and budget pacing. Manage social publishing, bilingual content, and engagement across approved channels. Coordinate approved online responses and route service cases to Customer Service. Build and optimize email and customer lifecycle campaigns, including segmentation, testing, and reporting, using approved systems and contact permissions. Coordinate website and landing-page updates, ensuring content accuracy, mobile usability, clear calls to action, and consistent campaign messaging. Improve SEO through keyword research, content, and recommendations to web teams. Support adoption of approved digital shipping tools by improving campaign journeys, educational content, and customer conversion paths. Implement and validate campaign links, tracking parameters, and conversion measurement with authorized analytics and technical teams. Monitor campaign lead capture and handover to Sales, checking data quality and agreeing follow-up feedback to improve lead relevance. Analyze the journey from enquiry to first-time buyer and revenue where data is available, working with Sales on shared conversion outcomes. Maintain dashboards covering spend, traffic, engagement, qualified leads, conversion rates, and cost per acquisition, with clear metric definitions. Test audiences, creative, email, and landing pages; document improvement opportunities. Brief and coordinate digital agencies and content partners, reviewing deliverables, campaign settings, and performance against agreed objectives. Adapt campaign assets with the Marketing Specialist, maintaining brand consistency. Coordinate with regional, IT, and platform owners on access, integrations, tracking issues, and technical changes requiring their support. Maintain campaign records and approved access in line with company data-handling rules. Prepare monthly performance reports and recommendations, highlighting budget use, results, risks, and opportunities to the Marketing & Communications Manager. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Business, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. At least 3 years of hands-on experience executing and optimizing digital campaigns. Strong Arabic and English communication and digital content adaptation skills. Practical experience with paid search, paid social, social media publishing, and email marketing platforms. Working knowledge of web analytics, campaign tracking, conversion measurement, SEO, and content management systems. Ability to analyze campaign data, diagnose issues, and recommend practical actions. Proficiency in Excel and dashboards; Power BI experience is an advantage. Experience working with Sales on lead quality, follow-up feedback, and conversion. Strong project coordination, agency management, and responsible data-handling skills. Relevant platform certifications and experience in Saudi Arabia, B2B services, logistics, or e-commerce are an advantage. For internal applicants: completion of a minimum of 18 months in the current role or pre-authorization from the line manager to apply. Our Offer DHL provides strong career support within an international environment, fostering a positive culture and collaborative colleagues. The company offers a multifarious benefit program.

b62784313d77710f.description: About CSI Global CSI Global specializes in providing advanced electromechanical, testing, and commissioning services across the GCC and globally. The company focuses on powering infrastructure through technical excellence and engineering innovation, contributing to the development of transmission and energy systems. Position Summary CSI Global is seeking a Sr. Commissioning Electrical Engineer to lead the end-to-end commissioning of MV/LV power systems and their interfaces with MEP systems (HVAC, Fire, BMS). This full-time role, based in Riyadh, involves ensuring assets achieve safe, compliant, and fully documented handover (FAC) on time and to specification. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Plan and execute commissioning programs, aligning with the construction master schedule, and maintain a live Commissioning Activity Tracker (CAT) and punch/defect logs. Witness and validate tests against project specifications and international standards (IEC/BS EN/NFPA), issue completion certificates, and close comments for final acceptance. Prepare and review test procedures, ITPs, test packs, IRN/IRE, PSAT/SAT reports, and observation NCRs, ensuring version control and audit-ready documentation. Coordinate daily with General Contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and consultants regarding prerequisites, energization windows, and permit-to-work. Supervise and sign off on the commissioning of MV switchgear, RMU, transformers, LV switchboards/DBs, MCCs, VFDs, PFC, emergency power systems (genset/UPS), earthing & bonding, protection & metering. Validate MEP system commissioning interfaces (HVAC/Plumbing/Fire/BMS) from an electrical perspective, including power-up readiness, interlocks, controls, alarms, and IST participation. Draft and deliver O&M and training manuals, spares lists, and warranties, and support training and client sign-off. Lead regular progress, technical, and commissioning meetings, identify risks early, and implement recovery plans. Manage day-to-day ELV commissioning planning, priorities, and resourcing, maintaining live trackers and punch/defect logs. Required Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in commissioning electrical systems. Work Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b65a7a2a42102a38.description: About the Role Nestlé Waters & Premium Beverage is seeking a GR Officer to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role focuses on fostering strong relationships with external communities, including customers and suppliers, and ensuring alignment between company policies and public interests. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to manage interactions and cooperation with external stakeholders, assess the company's public perception, and bridge any gaps between company procedures and public attention. The GR Officer will play a crucial role in representing the company and facilitating smooth operations with government entities. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain long-term relationships with government authorities to proactively address and resolve company-related issues. Represent the company in interactions with government authorities, resolving issues, and responding to inquiries. Coordinate effectively with various government departments and institutions to support the company's objectives and activities. Participate in the planning and organization of programs for guests and formal company occasions. Operate and manage tasks across all relevant governmental platforms. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a similar role. Demonstrated ability to build and maintain professional relationships with external entities. Experience in navigating and utilizing governmental platforms. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Dammam, within the Eastern Region. The role involves regular interaction with various external stakeholders and government bodies. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b6b460ea19cfabce.description: About Ninja Ninja is seeking an experienced Stock Control Supervisor to join its team. This full-time role will be based within the Central Warehouse, focusing on leading and overseeing inventory control activities. Role Overview The Stock Control Supervisor will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of inventory operations. This position involves supervising daily activities, managing inventory discrepancies, and coordinating with various internal departments to maintain compliance and drive continuous improvement in stock control processes. Key Responsibilities Supervise daily stock control activities to ensure inventory accuracy. Plan and oversee cycle counts, targeted counts, and inventory audits. Investigate inventory discrepancies and identify root causes. Review and validate inventory adjustments according to approved procedures. Lead the stock control team and allocate daily workloads. Monitor inventory accuracy KPIs and prepare performance reports. Coordinate with Warehouse Operations, Finance, IT/WMS, Quality & Safety, and other relevant teams. Ensure compliance with inventory control procedures and audit requirements. Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in stock control or a related field. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced warehouse environment. Work Environment This role operates within a central warehouse setting, requiring a proactive approach to inventory management and team leadership. The position demands adaptability to a dynamic operational environment. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

b6d21c95dfa08d31.description: About the Opportunity Ahmed Almadani Law Firm invites licensed Saudi lawyers to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role involves working on legal cases and consultations for individuals and entities, contributing to the delivery of accurate and clear legal services based on factual understanding, system analysis, and client needs. The firm is seeking a lawyer with 5-10 years of experience who can responsibly manage assigned files, demonstrate proficiency in legal research, drafting, and advocacy, and meticulously organize their work and appointments. Role and Responsibilities The successful candidate will handle litigation, research, and legal consultations under the supervision of the Litigation Department Manager, ensuring high-quality outputs, adherence to deadlines, professional confidentiality, and compliance with approved authorities. The role includes office work, attending court sessions, and conducting field visits, in coordination with the Litigation Department Manager and within the approved scope of assignments. Litigation and Case Management: Study cases, analyze facts and documents, prepare lawsuits, memos, requests, and objections. Represent clients, attend sessions, and follow up on procedures, execution, and field visits within the scope of assignment and power of attorney. Legal Research: Conduct documented legal research, analyze relevant laws, regulations, principles, and judicial precedents, and extract findings to support the handling of legal files and issues. Legal Opinions and Consultations: Prepare clear opinions and consultations that define the legal position, available options, risks, and practical recommendations, presenting them for review and approval before submission to the client. Contracts and Settlements: Draft and review contracts and agreements, identify contractual risks, propose appropriate remedies, and participate in negotiations and settlements. File Management and Documentation: Monitor deadlines and statutory periods, accurately and timely document developments, documents, correspondence, and record professional time. Complete file closure procedures and handover. Communication and Reporting: Follow up on client requirements, update them on file developments according to the approved communication mechanism, submit periodic reports to the Litigation Department Manager, and escalate risks, consequences, and out-of-scope tasks. Quality and Development: Adhere to technical review, participate in knowledge sharing, develop templates and work methods, and responsibly use technology tools, verifying the accuracy of their outputs before adoption. Essential Requirements Bachelor's degree in Law, Regulations, or Sharia from a recognized university. Valid Saudi lawyer's license and professional registration permitting practice at the time of employment. Minimum of two years of practical experience within the Kingdom in litigation and legal file management, with the ability to detail actual tasks undertaken and the role played. Experience in preparing judicial memos and requests, following up on sessions, procedures, and deadlines, and practical knowledge of Saudi laws related to handled cases. Proficiency in Arabic, both written and spoken, with the ability to draft organized and accurate legal documents and clearly explain their content. Proficiency in using the Najiz platform, judicial platforms, document preparation tools, and the ability to interact with relevant government platforms and case management systems. Accuracy and speed in documenting developments, including recording session updates, procedures, correspondence, and decisions immediately upon receipt in the approved system, verifying information and attachments, and clearly defining resulting procedures and deadlines. Ability to work physically in Jeddah, attend sessions and field visits, and willingness to travel for work-related assignments as per office arrangements. Preferred Experience Focused experience in relevant areas such as commercial, civil, or labor disputes, or enforcement and rights recovery. Experience in disputes related to estates, endowments, and personal status, including proving endowments, inventorying heirs, and guardianships before courts and relevant departments. Experience in company formation, amendment of articles of association, partners' resolutions, and general assembly minutes, in addition to preparing governance regulations and guides for joint-stock and family companies, and family charters. Experience in reviewing commercial contracts or providing legal consultations to entities. Proficiency in English for reading legal documents and correspondence is an added advantage for this role. Experience in legal practice management systems, or in developing templates and organizing legal knowledge. Relevant professional qualifications or specialized studies, supported by clear practical application ability. Work Style Expectations Accuracy and Professional Judgment: Verify facts and sources, and know when review or escalation is necessary. Responsibility and Organization: Follow up on tasks until completion, report risks early, and maintain clear deadlines and priorities. Communication and Teamwork: Present opinions concisely and clearly, listen well, and accept and benefit from feedback. Integrity and Confidentiality: Adhere to assignment limits, disclose conflicts of interest, and protect client and firm information. Initiative and Development: Propose practical solutions and improvements that enhance work quality and efficiency, and use technology responsibly with human verification of outputs. Work Schedule and Compensation This role offers practical experience in litigation and consultation, and participation in file discussions and the development of legal outputs within the team. The workdays are Sunday to Thursday, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with flexible break times and attendance adjustments for court sessions or field tasks. Overtime work is arranged when needed, according to approved regulations and policies. The monthly salary will be determined after the personal interview and technical assessment, based on qualifications, experience, and professional competence, and will be specified in the job offer. Application Process Please apply via the "Apply" button on this page. Attach an updated CV detailing professional licensing, practical experience, and types of cases handled. Clearly state the duration of training and post-licensing practice separately. Accurately answer the preliminary questions in the application. The selection process begins with a review of the CV and preliminary answers, assessing the relevance of experience to the job requirements. Candidates may be invited for a professional interview and practical assessment in Arabic to measure analytical skills, legal drafting, file management, and related technical skills. Qualifications, licensing, and experience will be verified before completing the hiring procedures. When describing experiences or work examples, please state the candidate's personal role without mentioning client names or attaching confidential documents or information. Ahmed Almadani Law Firm is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities, providing a supportive work environment to ensure their success. Selection is based on competence, relevant experience, and job requirements.

b6d48afbff403519.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Commercial (Citywide) to join its team. This full-time role, identified as MAS373, is central to driving the financial performance and strategic direction of the company's projects. Role Overview The Commercial Director will lead the commercial and reporting aspects of various initiatives. The primary focus of this position is to provide critical insights that optimize operational effectiveness and ensure alignment with overall business objectives. This role requires a professional with over 15 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement comprehensive commercial strategies to drive revenue growth and maximize profitability across all projects. Oversee the preparation of detailed financial reports, forecasting, and performance analysis to support informed decision-making. Collaborate with finance and project management teams to ensure accurate budgeting, cost control, and effective financial management. Establish and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor project and operational performance effectively. Ensure compliance with financial regulations and company policies across all commercial activities. Conduct market analysis to identify opportunities for revenue generation and cost savings. Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders and partners to enhance collaboration and support business interests. Lead and mentor the commercial reporting team, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Required Experience Candidates for this position must possess a minimum of 15 years of relevant professional experience in commercial leadership and financial reporting. Work Type This is a full-time position within Qiddiya Investment Company. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be provided to qualified candidates.

b6dcc4e93e3201e3.description: About KEO Group KEO Group is a creative enterprise offering end-to-end services in planning, design, and project delivery within the built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant projects globally. The firm is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. World Architecture ranks KEO as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. The Role KEO Group is seeking a Document Controller to join its Site Supervision team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for establishing, implementing, and managing a robust and auditable document control system throughout the construction and Defects Liability Period of projects. The Document Controller ensures that all project documentation, including technical submissions, correspondence, records, and reports, is properly received, tracked, distributed, archived, and retrieved in accordance with project procedures, service order requirements, and industry best practices, including the use of Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS) such as Aconex. Key Responsibilities Establish and maintain a comprehensive Document Control System for the project duration, including the construction phase and 12-month Defects Liability Period. Implement and manage the use of approved EDMS (*, Aconex or equivalent) for all project documentation. Develop and enforce standard document numbering, filing, and transmittal procedures in line with client and consultant requirements. Receive, log, and distribute all Contractor submissions, including Shop Drawings, Material Approval Requests (MARs), Method Statements, Technical Specifications, Calculations, RFIs, As-Built Drawings, and O&M Manuals. Maintain a live tracker of all submissions with clear status updates (Received, Under Review, Approved, Rejected, Revised). Ensure timely return of reviewed documents with Comment Review Sheets (CRS) and track the open/close status of comments. Control all incoming and outgoing project correspondence, instructions, notices, and reports between the Consultant, Client, Contractor, and other stakeholders. Prepare and issue formal transmittals and maintain accurate records of all communications. Support the team in preparing and compiling Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Reports. Ensure all quality-related documentation (ITPs, MIRs, WIRs, inspection records, test results, NCRs) is properly filed and easily retrievable. Support the compilation of the Project Completion Dossier and Handover Package in accordance with the client's Asset Completion and Handover Procedure. Maintain records for audit, claims, variations, and regulatory compliance purposes. Provide accurate document status updates for Weekly and Monthly Progress Meetings. Prepare document control metrics and reports as required by the Senior Project Manager/Project Director. Archive all project records in a structured, secure, and indexed manner at project close-out. Provide training and guidance to the supervision team on document control procedures and EDMS usage. Coordinate with discipline leads (Construction Managers, Inspectors, HSE) to ensure timely review and response to submissions. Qualifications and Requirements This position is open to KSA Nationals only. Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of relevant Document Control experience on major construction projects. Proven experience with Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) platforms such as Aconex, SharePoint, or equivalent. Strong knowledge of FIDIC contracts and construction project documentation workflows. Required Skills and Competencies Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and EDMS software. Ability to work independently and manage high volumes of documentation under pressure. Understanding of construction processes, shop drawings, technical submissions, and quality records. Commitment to confidentiality and data integrity.

b6305eeb642b4403.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Shift Leader to join their team in Riyadh and Ad Dir'iyah. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and involves overseeing operational tasks and supporting management in various functions to ensure smooth facility operations and guest satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Install, maintain, and perform preventative maintenance on tools, appliances, and equipment, recommending replacements as needed. Calibrate controls, gauges, and meters, and identify/operate all shut-off valves. Order, mark, and stock parts and supplies, maintaining inventory and purchase order logs. Inspect tools, equipment, and machines, and utilize computer systems for work-related information. Operate power lifts and complete life safety checklists, including fire-pump and generator run tests. Inspect fire sprinkler valves and alarm systems, and assist in developing disaster response protocols. Respond to and address guest repair requests promptly. Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Adhere to all company and safety/security policies, report maintenance problems, hazards, accidents, or injuries, and complete required safety training. Ensure professional appearance, maintain confidentiality, and acknowledge guests according to company standards. Anticipate and address guest service needs, including assisting individuals with disabilities. Foster positive working relationships, support team goals, and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Ensure adherence to quality standards and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and cost-savings. Communicate professionally and clearly with others. Physical Requirements Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight. Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Team Environment The Shift Leader will be part of the Marriott International team, specifically within The Luxury Collection Hotels & Resorts portfolio. This collection, with over 120 properties globally, focuses on delivering authentic experiences and personalized hospitality. The team values individuals who appreciate storytelling, have a passion for local heritage, and are committed to genuine service. Additional Duties The Shift Leader will perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

b6c104b8d20bcb80.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أف أن أي جي للتجارة عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، مع توفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات والتعامل مع عمليات الدفع. المسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات شاملة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بشكل دوري والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات اللازمة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بكفاءة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والعرض. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل ديناميكي في قطاع التجارة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

b609bbdc09069d24.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise with over 60 years of experience, specializing in planning, design, and project delivery within built and natural environments. The company provides end-to-end services from conceptualization to realization. KEO is recognized as a Top 225 International Design Firm and a Top 20 International PM/CM Firm by ENR, and ranked as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region by World Architecture's 2024 WA100 Survey. KEO fosters a supportive environment for professional development, offering internal global mobility and career growth opportunities. The company prioritizes employee well-being through on-demand counseling and workplace clinics, and encourages participation in community events. KEO also provides a competitive package and benefits, including hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, and employee referral rewards. BIM Coordinator (Tamheer) Internship Overview KEO International Consultants is seeking a BIM Coordinator intern to join its PMO Division in Riyadh. This internship is part of the Tamheer program and is designed for students pursuing a relevant degree, offering 0-1 years of experience. The role focuses on supporting BIM coordination activities across various project disciplines under the guidance of the BIM team. Key Responsibilities Support BIM coordination activities across project disciplines under supervision. Review BIM models and project documentation in accordance with project BIM requirements, DC-EIR, the BIM Management Plan, and ISO 19650 principles. Assist in reviewing Revit and Navisworks models for coordination, quality, and compliance. Support federated model management, model segregation, multidisciplinary coordination, and clash detection. Perform basic BIM model QA/QC checks using established project checklists and review procedures. Review BIM documentation, including BEP, MIDP, TIDPs, LOIN, MDS, AIR, Model Registers, and other BIM deliverables. Track BIM deliverables, contractor submissions, review status, and project submission requirements. Utilize Aconex and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) to support BIM information management and document submission workflows. Maintain BIM registers, issue logs, model registers, and corrective-action tracking records. Monitor contractor BIM submissions and support verification against project BIM and DC-EIR requirements. Assist in identifying coordination issues and documenting findings for follow-up and resolution. Prepare BIM review checklists, coordination reports, progress reports, and supporting documentation. Participate in BIM coordination meetings and support the recording and monitoring of coordination actions. Monitor BIM progress and support the tracking of outstanding deliverables and corrective actions. Support BIM compliance reviews and project handover requirements. Coordinate with relevant project team members to support timely BIM information exchange and resolution of model-related issues. Develop practical knowledge of BIM standards, information management processes, and project-specific BIM requirements through supervised project activities. Candidate Requirements Must be a Saudi national. Must not have been previously registered on Tamheer. Hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering. For Co-op and Internship placements, applicants must be eligible to complete the program as part of their academic requirements and provide necessary university documentation upon request. Candidates must currently reside in Riyadh and be available to work in Riyadh for the duration of the program. Work Location This internship is based at the KEO International Consultants office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

b6754f0647bd9a58.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Director - Commercial (Development Accounting) to lead the commercial strategy, governance, and performance for major development, construction, infrastructure, and real estate programs. This full-time role involves ensuring value optimization, cost control, and commercial risk management across the project portfolio. The Senior Director will provide executive leadership for commercial planning, procurement strategy, contract management, claims management, and financial performance. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead the commercial strategy for major programs, projects, and portfolios. Oversee commercial governance, cost management, procurement strategy, contract administration, and financial controls. Provide executive oversight of pre-contract and post-contract commercial activities across the project lifecycle. Lead commercial evaluations, business cases, procurement approaches, and contract award recommendations. Manage high-value commercial negotiations with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and strategic partners. Oversee contract performance, change management, claims management, dispute resolution, and commercial risk mitigation activities. Monitor project financial performance, forecasts, budgets, commitments, and cost reporting. Collaborate with Development, Project Delivery, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and Executive Leadership teams to support project objectives. Ensure compliance with commercial policies, governance frameworks, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements. Lead value engineering, cost optimization, and commercial improvement initiatives. Provide commercial insights and recommendations to executive leadership and governance committees. Demonstrated ability to drive commercial excellence and support successful project delivery. Experience in effective stakeholder engagement, negotiation, and commercial decision-making. Application Process Candidates interested in this Senior Director position are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b67fbcded9bcb7ad.company_name: Yanbu Aramco Sinopec Refining Company (YASREF) Ltd.
b67fbcded9bcb7ad.description: About the COOP Trainee Program Yanbu Aramco Sinopec Refining Company (YASREF) Ltd. offers COOP trainee opportunities in Yanbu, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This program is designed for high-caliber Saudi students to gain practical work experience and fulfill university or college graduation requirements. Participants will be evaluated at the end of the program to determine their overall grade for the required COOP credits. Program Objectives The primary objective of the COOP Trainee Program is to provide students with hands-on experience in a professional environment. This internship is intended to bridge the gap between academic learning and practical application, ensuring participants meet the necessary prerequisites for their academic degrees. Eligibility Criteria Applicants for the COOP Trainee Program must meet specific criteria as required by their universities or colleges for practical training prior to graduation. Selection is based on slot availability and the following requirements: Applicants must have a minimum cumulative GPA of out of 4 / out of 5 for technical majors, or out of 4 / out of 5 for non-technical majors, or an equivalent. Priority will be given to candidates with the highest GPAs. Applicants must not have graduated from their university or college. Applicants must commit to completing the entire COOP training period. Accepted students must not be enrolled in university classes or modules during their training period. Required Documents for Application To apply for the COOP Trainee Program, candidates are required to submit the following documents: A copy of the Government ID. A copy of the latest official academic transcript. A formal letter from the university or college outlining the objectives and duration of the program. Experience and Work Type This is an internship opportunity suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, specifically designed for students seeking to fulfill academic requirements through practical training. The program offers a foundational experience in a professional setting. Location and Compensation The COOP Trainee positions are located in Yanbu, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. Salary details for this internship program are not disclosed.

b6b5f248751bd1e7.description: About Artas Real Estate Artas Real Estate is seeking a Real Estate Sales Specialist to join their team in Makkah. This full-time role is designed for experienced sales professionals who excel in client management and consistently achieve sales targets within the real estate sector. Role Overview The Real Estate Sales Specialist will be responsible for managing both off-plan (Wafi) and ready unit sales. The primary objective is to deliver a professional and seamless client experience, from initial contact through to the successful closing of deals. This role requires a strong focus on client satisfaction and sales performance. Key Responsibilities Handle sales of both off-plan (Wafi) and ready real estate units. Provide a professional and seamless client experience from initial contact to deal closure. Effectively manage client relationships and address their needs. Consistently achieve and exceed sales targets. Prepare mortgage and financing calculations for clients. Qualifications and Requirements Saudi National. Minimum of 5 years of experience in real estate sales. Proven ability to close deals and meet sales targets. Strong communication, negotiation, and client-handling skills. Ability to understand client needs and provide suitable solutions. High level of commitment, discipline, and adaptability. Professional presence and confidence when dealing with clients. b6a5a6f105431c78.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة خبراء الغذاء التجارية عن مصمم جرافيك للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير الأفكار والمفاهيم الإبداعية لتوصيل الرسائل المطلوبة عبر وسائل الجرافيك، بالإضافة إلى تصميم الإنتاج لمختلف الوسائط الإعلامية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية التنسيق مع أصحاب التصميم، سواء كانوا عملاء داخليين أو خارجيين، لفهم الرسالة المستهدفة وتحديد المتطلبات والاتفاق على المنتج النهائي. تطوير مفاهيم تصميم عامة تلبي احتياجات العميل، وصياغة أسلوب يتناسب مع الصورة والوضع المطلوبين. تقديم المشورة الفنية المتعلقة بمفاهيم التصميم العامة، وتقديم الإرشادات حول المتطلبات الأسلوبية مثل الألوان والصور ونمط النص والتخطيط لضمان توصيل الرسالة بفعالية. تسليم المنتج النهائي للعميل، وجمع الملاحظات، وإجراء التعديلات اللازمة بناءً عليها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالمشاريع، وعرضها، وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تصميم الجرافيك. القدرة على تطوير أفكار إبداعية ومفاهيم تصميمية. معرفة بوضع المخططات العامة وتصميم الإنتاج للإعلانات والمجلات وتقارير الشركات ووسائل الإعلام الأخرى. بيئة العمل يعمل مصمم الجرافيك ضمن فريق في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، في بيئة عمل بدوام كامل. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء الداخليين والخارجيين لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التصميمية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

b6c82bd975ebbdfd.description: About Stanley Black & Decker Stanley Black & Decker is a global company with approximately 48,000 professionals worldwide, known for brands such as DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®. The company focuses on innovation and making an impact For Those Who Make The World™. Key Account Specialist Role Stanley Black & Decker is seeking a Key Account Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This permanent role involves generating demand for professional power tools and accessories, managing key accounts, and conducting market research. The specialist will work to convert inquiries into orders, develop market penetration strategies, and increase brand share among customers. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Responsibilities Generate demand for professional power tools and accessories by providing effective job-site solutions to end-users. Manage key accounts (end-users) and ensure inquiries are converted into orders through collaboration with sales teams and distribution. Conduct market research on new products and communicate customer feedback to Marketing/product management teams. Develop and implement strategies to cover, penetrate, acquire, and protect the industrial product group business in the target market. Increase brand share with end-users. Plan and execute regular visits to key accounts to build relationships and identify end-user needs, proposing and expediting solutions. Maintain up-to-date product knowledge and demonstrate effective solutions for end-user applications, highlighting features and benefits. Ensure marketing objectives are met by focusing on categories that increase brand share. Provide product and safety training to end-users to enhance productivity through correct tool usage. Manage new product launches and ensure account retention. Liaise with sales teams and dealers to ensure efficient processing of quotations and orders. Achieve annual sell-out targets based on focus categories and new product sell-out targets. Achieve new customer acquisition targets. Communicate and implement marketing campaigns to end-users. Prepare key account reports in prescribed formats for management review. Support marketing events such as dealer/end-user meets and roadshows. Maintain demonstration products and vehicles in good working condition. Qualifications and Requirements 3-5 years of relevant end-user sales experience. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Sales, or Marketing. An MBA is an advantage. Excellent interpersonal skills for public representation, media events, product launches, demonstrations, and trade shows. Strong communication skills for interacting with customers, suppliers, and team members. Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. Proficiency in computer skills for report generation, marketing metrics, data extraction, and familiarity with e-commerce platforms and social media. Benefits Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits plan. Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and partner programs. Opportunities for career growth within a global company featuring over 20 brands and multiple career paths. Access to extensive learning resources, including a digital learning portal. A work environment that values mutual respect and diverse perspectives. Opportunities to engage in volunteerism and sustainable business practices.

b6caaf82a9233ff8.job_title: Demi Chef De Partie The EDITION
b6caaf82a9233ff8.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Sous Chef-Junior to join their team in Medina. This is a full-time, entry-level management position focused on achieving daily kitchen objectives. The role involves assisting in leading kitchen staff while actively participating in all kitchen operations, including food production, purchasing, and maintaining sanitation standards. The Sous Chef-Junior contributes to ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while adhering to the operating budget. Candidates should have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Maintain food handling and sanitation standards within the kitchen. Oversee the production and preparation of culinary items, ensuring quality standards are met. Lead shifts, personally preparing food items and executing requests according to specifications. Supervise and coordinate the activities of cooks and other food preparation staff. Work with Restaurant and Banquet departments to coordinate service and timing of events and meals. Assist in determining food presentation and creating decorative food displays. Ensure employees maintain clean and sanitary work areas. Comply with loss prevention policies and procedures. Team Leadership and Support Supervise daily shift operations, ensuring proper staffing levels to meet operational and financial objectives. Ensure all employees have necessary supplies, equipment, and uniforms. Participate in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed. Address employee questions and concerns, communicating performance expectations clearly. Conduct training sessions when appropriate and monitor employee progress. Operational Management Participate in department meetings, communicating departmental goals to achieve desired results. Support and assist with the development of new menus, concepts, and promotions for restaurant outlets and banquets. Purchase appropriate supplies and manage food and supply inventories within budget. Report malfunctions in department equipment promptly. Guest Service Focus Set a positive example for guest relations and service delivery. Handle guest problems and complaints, escalating to a supervisor when necessary. Empower employees to provide excellent customer service within established guidelines. Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in a culinary role. Demonstrated ability to maintain food handling and sanitation standards. Experience in supervising and coordinating kitchen staff activities. Strong understanding of food production, purchasing, and inventory management. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced kitchen environment.

b6f9e06a6bb68246.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد المخطط، وتقدير كمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية والمواصفات الفنية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الفني. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، ويقدم الدعم المباشر للمهندسين الكهربائيين في مشاريع الشركة المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

b610a1d9d8e49c44.description: About the Role PSA BDP is seeking a Projects & Heavy Lifts Product Manager to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves developing and managing business within the projects and heavy lifts sector, focusing on key industrial verticals. The successful candidate will be responsible for both business development and operational oversight of project logistics. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities within the Oil & Gas, Energy, Construction, and other industrial sectors in KSA. Nurture and develop relationships with existing and key customers through regular face-to-face meetings. Source vendors, procure rates, and develop solutions for customer requests. Identify project risks and recommend appropriate resolutions. Prepare and submit quotes, proposals, method statements, and transportation plans for prospective and existing clients. Provide onsite support for supervision of loading/unloading, packing, and coordination of project moves. Develop project budgets with a focus on cost optimization and reduction. Ensure project execution adheres to defined budgets and timelines. Manage the project vendor team to ensure effective and efficient operational execution. Conduct regular project status meetings with the project team and provide timely progress updates to customers. Address questions and concerns from the project team, management, and customers professionally. Ensure project deliverables meet customer expectations and provide support and guidance to the project team as needed. Ensure compliance with all internal procedures and government regulations. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; additional qualifications in supply chain management are beneficial. A minimum of 10 years of experience in project and heavy lift transport, or within the Oil & Gas, Energy EPC, or construction verticals. Demonstrated operations background with experience in pricing, procurement, and commercial aspects. Required Skills Excellent knowledge of the KSA markets. Ability to adapt quickly to changing policies and procedures. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, requiring active engagement with clients and vendors in the Eastern Region and across KSA.

b699a647eebe290c.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform recognized as a Great Place to Work®. With over 25 years of conversational AI research and development, Unifonic serves more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA. The company is pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. The Role of Arabic Linguist – AI & TTS Unifonic is seeking an Arabic Linguist to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This is a part-time position focused on supporting the Text-to-Speech (TTS) team. The role involves linguistic analysis, providing Arabic dialect expertise, evaluating pronunciation and speech quality, and contributing to voice-related projects. The Arabic Linguist will apply linguistic expertise to production projects aimed at enhancing the quality, accuracy, and naturalness of Arabic speech technology. Key Responsibilities Conducting research on the phonological, morphological, and syntactic structures of Arabic, with a focus on Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and Saudi/Gulf dialects (particularly the Najdi dialect), and providing linguistic guidance for their integration into Sestek products. Acting as a linguistic point of contact for the R&D / AI team and translating linguistic requirements into clear, actionable input for engineers. Analyzing and reviewing pronunciation data, including grapheme-to-phoneme mappings, diacritization/tashkeel, and lexicons, for Arabic TTS and speech recognition systems. Evaluating TTS output quality in terms of pronunciation accuracy, prosody, dialect authenticity, and naturalness, with a particular focus on Saudi Arabic. Providing linguistic guidance and support for Arabic voice data collection and speech synthesis projects, including identifying and onboarding suitable voice talents when needed. Supporting the coordination and review of voice recording and editing processes to ensure linguistic accuracy and consistency. Supporting the onboarding and coordination of external Arabic language consultants when needed and providing guidance on linguistic requirements. Reviewing and providing linguistic feedback on data annotation activities and guidelines, ensuring appropriate quality standards for Arabic and Saudi dialect data. Collaborating closely with the Sestek TTS and AI Research teams and providing ongoing linguistic expertise throughout the project. Benefits Unifonic offers a range of benefits to its employees, including a competitive salary and bonus structure. Employees are eligible for the Unifonic share scheme. After the first anniversary, employees receive 30 holiday days annually, in addition to their birthday off. The company also provides the option to work remotely for up to 25 days per year and offers paid leave for new parents.

b65e535af38615c4.description: About the Role Hitachi is seeking an experienced professional for the role of Team Lead - Operation Quality. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, and requires 8-10 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will apply practical knowledge in a high-quality manufacturing or assembly environment, focusing on delivering world-class quality and driving continuous improvements. Key Responsibilities Lead a team of quality engineers and technicians, including planning and implementing team development and achieving performance goals. Arrange and perform shop floor activities related to quality checking of products, incoming material quality, production, and testing processes. Take responsibility for process development, procedures, templates, and working instructions concerning operations quality and incoming quality. Collaborate with and empower all departments for deviation detection, nonconformance follow-ups, root cause analysis, correction measures implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Support in resolving quality issues from the GIS assembly line or site, and follow up on NCR-related improvement actions. Attend and participate in internal or external audits (ISO, Hitachi Energy, Customer), working with all departments to close findings and implement improvements. Participate in organizational changes and lean culture implementation within the Business Unit. Implement and monitor the quality strategy for materials, customer complaints, and processes using predefined quality KPIs. Arrange and perform failure analysis, prepare reports using 8D templates or similar, and maintain a safe environment by implementing HSE requirements. Monitor supplier quality performance and follow up on corrective actions related to NCRs, CCRPs, and suppliers. Ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Uphold Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, taking responsibility for personal actions while caring for colleagues and the business. Required Qualifications and Experience 8-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to resolve HV Site Non-conformance issues. Proven experience in a high-quality manufacturing or assembly environment. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic team focused on operational quality and continuous improvement.

b66b3311ae17a0f9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث وكالة اعلانك الماسي للدعاية والاعلان عن مصمم إعلان للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم الإعلانات والمواد الدعائية، وتطوير المفاهيم الإبداعية، واختيار التخطيط والمحتوى المناسبين لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التسويقية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير مفاهيم التصميم العامة للإعلانات والمواد الدعائية، بما في ذلك المنشورات والطوابع ووسائل الإعلام المطبوعة والرقمية. تطوير أسلوب تصميم يتناسب مع الصورة والوضع المرغوبين للعملاء. دراسة أهداف وغايات الإعلان وعناصر التصميم لمخطط الإعلان أو المنشور أو الطوابع بما يتناسب مع مفاهيم التصاميم العامة. تحديد المتطلبات الأسلوبية للتصاميم، مثل الألوان والخطوط والرسومات. العمل مع مزودي المحتوى لضمان إدراجه بفعالية في الإعلان وتحديد عناصر الطوابع أو محتويات المنشورات. ضمان الاتساق التام مع مفاهيم التصميم العامة والمعايير المحددة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال التصميم. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصميم الإعلاني. إجادة العمل على برنامج Photoshop لتصميم الإعلانات والمواد الدعائية. القدرة على تطوير مفاهيم التصميم والرؤية الإبداعية. مهارات قوية في اختيار التخطيط والمحتوى المناسبين للتصاميم. بيئة العمل العمل في هذا الدور بدوام كامل ضمن مكتب دعاية وإعلان في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التعاون مع فريق العمل لتقديم حلول تصميمية مبتكرة وفعالة.

b6398582a3ac8168.description: About Alstom Alstom specializes in transport networks, offering a broad portfolio that includes high-speed trains, metros, monorails, trams, turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility solutions. The company focuses on greener and smarter mobility, connecting cities and reducing carbon emissions. Alstom operates in 63 countries with over 80,000 employees worldwide. The Role of Logistics Engineer Alstom is seeking a Logistics Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 year of experience. The Logistics Engineer will be responsible for optimizing logistics flows and ensuring seamless operations and project success within a new cutting-edge field. The role involves close collaboration with various internal and external teams. Key Responsibilities Designing the project warehouse to meet specific operational needs. Ensuring the definition of material and information flows at the project's inception. Developing and providing appropriate training for team members to enhance their skills and performance. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize supply chain and planning activities. Driving a culture of resilience, adaptability, and continuous learning within the logistics team. Supporting the continuous improvement of logistics processes to align with business objectives. Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates for the Logistics Engineer position should possess 0-1 year of experience in logistics and supply chain. The role requires expertise in optimizing logistics flows and ensuring operational efficiency. Applicants should be prepared to work closely with various teams and adhere to Health, Safety, and Environmental policies. Career Development and Benefits Alstom offers a professional environment where employees can develop new skills and experiences within the rail industry. The company provides opportunities to collaborate with transverse teams and contribute to efficient project delivery and supply chain optimization. Employees can work with global supply chains, suppliers, and cross-functional project teams. Alstom supports career progression across various functions and countries and offers a dynamic reward package that recognizes performance and potential, alongside comprehensive social coverage including life, medical, and pension benefits. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion Alstom is an equal-opportunity employer committed to celebrating diversity and creating an inclusive workplace for all employees across its global operations.

b650ebb57da6d6c8.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking an Executive Lounge Supervisor to oversee daily operations and deliver exceptional guest experiences in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading service standards, maintaining lounge presentation, and ensuring guest satisfaction for executive and VIP guests. Key Responsibilities Lead daily execution of Executive Lounge service standards to ensure a seamless guest experience. Uphold brand and quality standards to meet the expectations of executive and VIP guests. Respond to guest inquiries and complaints promptly and professionally. Ensure guest supplies are consistently stocked and lounge areas meet cleanliness and service standards. Guide team members to ensure they are knowledgeable about hotel services, VIP preferences, and local attractions, and consistently provide professional hospitality. Maintain compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations to ensure guest and team member well-being. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will demonstrate a commitment to hospitality, integrity, and leadership. This role requires a focus on teamwork, ownership, and accountability to drive positive outcomes and make a lasting impact. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Proven ability to oversee lounge operations and deliver high standards of service. Experience in leading and developing a team. Understanding of health, safety, and sanitation compliance. About Hilton Hilton is a global leader in hospitality, recognized for its workplace culture and commitment to guest experiences. The company focuses on providing a supportive environment for its team members, fostering career growth within the organization. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Riyadh. Salary information for this role is not disclosed.

b663123f3258b99d.description: About 2P Perfect Presentation Since 2004, 2P Perfect Presentation has been a key player in Saudi Arabia’s ICT sector, providing integrated technology solutions to support digital transformation and enhance operational efficiency for organizations. The company focuses on innovation and service excellence, delivering end-to-end solutions through specialized business units and market expertise. Collections Supervisor Role Overview 2P Perfect Presentation is seeking a skilled Collections Supervisor to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing collection operations, managing accounts receivable, and recovering payments from government entities and private-sector clients. The supervisor will ensure timely recovery of outstanding payments, support healthy cash flow, and work to minimize bad debt. Key Responsibilities Supervise the collections team and monitor daily performance. Track due and overdue invoices and establish collection priorities. Communicate directly with clients to follow up on outstanding payments and resolve payment-related issues. Develop collection plans and timelines, and monitor their execution. Prepare periodic management reports on accounts receivable, overdue balances, and collection rates. Coordinate with the Finance and Sales teams to resolve issues related to invoices and contracts. Follow up on the approval and payment of claims and project certificates with government entities in accordance with their procedures. Analyze the causes of payment delays and recommend practical measures to reduce bad debt. Ensure compliance with the company’s approved collection policies and procedures. Build and maintain strong relationships with client representatives to facilitate timely collections. Train, guide, and develop the collections team. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in supervising collection operations. Proven experience in managing accounts receivable. Demonstrated ability to collect payments from government entities in Saudi Arabia. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic environment focused on digital transformation and operational efficiency.

b670a29bf2b82364.description: About Red Sea Global and RSSE Red Sea Global (RSG) is a developer of regenerative tourism destinations. Red Sea Sports & Entertainment (RSSE), a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, is responsible for designing and delivering land and marine experiences at The Red Sea destination. RSSE manages and operates a portfolio of sports, adventure, and leisure offerings, including water sports through Galaxea, adventure activities via Akun, and leisure experiences delivered by WAMA. RSSE supports Saudi Vision 2030 by promoting inclusive, accessible, and world-class sports and recreational experiences. Role Overview: Instructor - Adventure The Instructor - Adventure plays a frontline role within The Red Sea destination, focusing on delivering safe, engaging, and memorable inland adventure experiences under the Akun Adventure portfolio. This full-time position supports the development of diverse trails and adventure activities, ensuring guest experiences align with Red Sea Sport & Entertainment standards. The Instructor collaborates with senior instructors, operations teams, and resort colleagues, leading adventure activities while upholding safety, environmental stewardship, and customer service. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Deliver and support the operation of all inland, land-based adventure activities across The Red Sea destination. Lead guests on Akun Adventure experiences, ensuring safety, engagement, and a premium outdoor experience. Conduct pre-activity briefings, including safety instructions, risk awareness, and experience expectations. Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols, SOPs, RAMS, and emergency procedures during all activities. Educate guests on environmental awareness, conservation principles, and responsible outdoor behavior. Maintain a professional, welcoming, and service-oriented approach when interacting with guests. Monitor weather conditions, terrain, and guest capability, adjusting activity plans as needed. Assist with trail exploration and assessment to identify optimal routes for adventure experiences. Support trip planning, logistics, equipment preparation, and vehicle readiness. Provide feedback, operational insights, and incident reports to the Senior Instructor and RSSE management. Support the maintenance and care of all adventure equipment, ensuring cleanliness and compliance with safety standards. Assist in the training, mentoring, and development of Adventure Specialists and junior team members. Promote and embody the Red Sea service style, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality guest experiences. Comply with all RSSE and Red Sea Global policies, processes, SOPs, and operational guidelines. Support the preparation of accurate and timely operational reports and MIS data. Apply safety, quality, and environmental management policies to ensure employee and guest safety and regulatory compliance. Actively contribute to a strong safety culture by identifying hazards, reporting risks, and supporting risk mitigation. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement across adventure operations and guest experiences. Stakeholder Collaboration The Instructor will collaborate with internal stakeholders including Senior Instructors, Adventure Operations, RSSE Operations Teams, and Resort & Hospitality Teams. External interactions will involve Guests, Local Authorities, and Environmental & Outdoor Activity Partners. Work Environment and Expectations This role operates primarily in outdoor and remote environments across The Red Sea destination. It requires physical fitness, environmental awareness, and flexibility in working hours. The Instructor is expected to represent Akun Adventure and Red Sea Sport & Entertainment with professionalism, integrity, and enthusiasm at all times, maintaining positive conduct with guests, colleagues, and stakeholders.

b698a90532ecff44.description: About the Role JLL is seeking a Senior Cost Manager to join one of its iconic projects in Riyadh. This full-time role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in cost management, demonstrating strong technical capabilities and sound commercial knowledge. The successful candidate will be instrumental in managing project costs and contributing to value optimization. Role Purpose and Contribution The Senior Cost Manager will be responsible for understanding the key drivers of cost and value within projects. This role involves capturing and sharing knowledge, as well as driving innovation in service delivery. The position requires a deep understanding of post-contract services and the ability to apply this knowledge effectively to project management. Key Responsibilities Provide cost and commercial support for the delivery of post-contract services. Manage and update project budgets accurately. Take suitable commercial meeting minutes to document discussions and decisions. Prepare cash flow reports and draft monthly payment recommendations. Develop weekly commercial dashboards to monitor project financial performance. Manage variations and assist in the close-out of projects, claims, and variations. b6e3d4905fb51092.description: About the Role شركة بسموق للمقاولات is seeking a skilled Carpenter to join our team in Riyadh. b672151e16f5c2ed.description: About Otis Otis is a global leader in elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service, moving billion people daily and maintaining approximately million customer units worldwide. The company operates in over 200 countries and territories, with a team of 72,000 professionals dedicated to meeting diverse customer and passenger needs. Otis is recognized for its legacy of innovation and commitment to safety, ethics, and quality. Role Overview Otis is seeking a Senior Project Engineer for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role is responsible for managing installation projects, ensuring timely completion, and adhering to business policies and procedures. The Senior Project Engineer will oversee manpower planning, equipment requisition, and site progress monitoring, as well as manage variation orders based on client specification changes. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage Pre-installation Works: Ensure availability of contractual scope of works and deliveries information. Plan material deliveries in coordination with factory and supply chain. Monitor shaft readiness and verify dimensions against approved shop drawings. Ensure adequate resource planning to meet project requirements. Award Purchase Orders for subcontractors and local materials in conjunction with the Project Manager and supply chain. Coordinate with External Stakeholders: Facilitate approval of shop drawings, technical submittals, material samples, method statements, and Inspection and Test Plans. Plan and arrange logistic programs for safe and timely material deliveries. Submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports to the main contractor as required. Attend weekly/bi-weekly meetings with the main contractor. Advise the main contractor of any scope deviations and process variation orders. Carry out technical coordination and planning for elevator interface with Low Voltage devices. Oversee Installation Phase: Ensure availability of adequate resources, including subcontractors and certified tools. Raise Material Inspection Requests upon material deliveries and approval. Maintain proper communication and record-keeping with the main contractor. Monitor installation progress using MS Projects, Primavera, or spreadsheets. Plan risk assessments for hoisting, rigging, and other critical activities. Conduct Tool Box Talks (TBT)/Field Pre-Task Assessments (FPA) and ensure adherence to safety procedures. Raise trouble reports for missing, short-shipped, or defective materials and follow up on deliveries. Provide advice and support to installation teams for any related issues. Ensure installation manuals, engineering drawings, and approved shop drawings are always available. Coordinate with the supply chain for timely ordering and availability of local materials. Ensure in-stage QA/QC is carried out according to company procedures. Ensure T&C plan and adjustor availability to meet project deadlines. Ensure timely readiness of Construction Time Usage as per project requirements. Ensure timely completion of Low Voltage interfaces to elevator systems. Ensure timely submission of monthly interim payment applications and follow up on payments. Carry out third-party inspections as required. Handover units to customers in line with company policy and project requirements. Coordinate with Internal Departments: Liaise with local engineering, factory, supply chain, and finance teams to fulfill project deliveries. Manage Project Budget: Prepare and present cost reviews to finance and management teams. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in project engineering or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage complex installation projects. Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Projects or Primavera. Strong understanding of safety procedures and quality control. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh.

b6a521424b6bf18f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية بهدف تطوير المنتجات والعمليات، بالإضافة إلى تحسين الطرق التحليلية وإعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الأبحاث والتجارب والتحاليل الكمية والنوعية للعناصر والمركبات العضوية واللاعضوية. تحديد الخواص الكيميائية والبنية والتفاعلات للمركبات وتحليل النتائج المستخلصة. تصميم وتطوير وسائل وأساليب وتجهيزات جديدة، وتحسين المعادلات والعمليات والطرق لحل المشكلات الفنية. إجراء الأبحاث على المنتجات الكيميائية المصنعة بهدف تطوير وتحسين الإجراءات والعمليات وجودة المنتجات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بنتائج الدراسات الفيزيائية وسبل تطويرها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الكيمياء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية المعقدة. مهارات قوية في التحليل الكمي والنوعي. بيئة العمل يعمل الكيميائي بدوام كامل في الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على الابتكار والتطوير المستمر في مجال الكيمياء. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل يسهم في تطوير المنتجات والعمليات الكيميائية. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل.

b6dbaf413cdb9bc5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة غصون الرعاية الطبية عن مهندس أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان التركيب الفعال، الصيانة، والتشخيص الدقيق للأجهزة الطبية، بالإضافة إلى تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيلها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهندسين حديثي التخرج أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج لتركيب الأجهزة الطبية، بما في ذلك أجهزة التصوير الإشعاعي والموجي، وأجهزة التشخيص والمعالجة. تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة الطبية بكفاءة وأمان. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الطبية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إجراء الفحوص الدورية للتأكد من دقة أداء الأجهزة الطبية. تطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في هندسة الأجهزة الطبية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الأجهزة الطبية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ تشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة الطبية المختلفة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على إعداد الخطط والبرامج الفنية. مهارات تدريبية جيدة لنقل المعرفة للمستخدمين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والتوثيق. الالتزام بتطوير الذات ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة غصون الرعاية الطبية، ملتزماً بتقديم أعلى معايير الجودة في خدمة الأجهزة الطبية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

b620b5fc2605271f.description: About Jazeera Paints Jazeera Paints is seeking a Driver to join their team in Al Baha. This is a full-time position focused on providing essential transportation services to support departmental operations. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient transportation services. The Driver will ensure the secure and timely transport of employees, documents, equipment, and materials as required to support the department's operational needs. Key Responsibilities Operate company vehicles safely for the transportation of staff, guests, and materials. Adhere to all traffic laws and maintain safe driving practices. Provide timely pick-up and drop-off services for employees and guests, including from airports, hotels, and other designated locations. Conduct regular inspections and maintenance checks on company vehicles to ensure optimal working condition. Report any vehicle maintenance issues promptly and coordinate necessary repairs. Plan efficient routes to maximize transportation time and fuel efficiency. Assist with the delivery and collection of HR and administrative documents, packages, and materials as instructed.
